customer_updates.text: I had an very nice experience highly recommended

featured_reviews.name: Pranav Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a really good experience at Don's Mahalaxmi. We got 2 of our cars ceramic coated with Graphene Matrix by Kovalent. The showroom seems a little small and open (giving concerns on dust control) but they know what they are doing.

Sufiyaan and Ali were very responsive, helpful, and clearly know their way around premium cars. When I dropped my cars off, I even saw an Aston Martin and a BYD sealion 7 there, which was reassuring.

We got ceramic coating done on two cars - one brand new and the other about a year old. The difference was especially visible on the older one, where the color really seemed to pop after the job. The team was also very accommodating in fixing any small issues that came up. They were always open to any feedback I had to share, which made the whole process smooth.

They created a WhatsApp group to communicate updates, provided free pickup/drop, performed a free inspection-cum-wash after a week and gave a microfiber with each car serviced.

Suggestion - budget a day or 2 extra than the communicated timelines. It may take longer.

Overall, very happy with the results and would definitely recommend them!

featured_reviews.review_text: I recently got ceramic treatment done on my BMW 530d and the results were outstanding. The finish, attention to detail, and overall workmanship were truly fantastic. I’m extremely satisfied and would highly recommend Detailing Dons, South Mumbai, to everyone looking for high-quality detailing services.

featured_reviews.review_text:

I wasn’t sure who would be a reliable source or experienced workshop to get my work done because when it comes to my car i expect a top notch service as it was a brand new car and hence after a lot of research i came across Detailing Dons. I mean what should i tell you about this guys they are awesome, the service and professionalism these guys conduct with their customer is excellent and just over the expectations. I opted for the premium ceramic coating 3 years package from them and till date it’s 7 months my car looks new as its freshly done.
Ceramic Coating done over my car has provided unmatched protection to the paint and with almost no swirl marks on the car left if proper care taken every wash till date gives me that hydrophobic effect which repells water and makes it easier for me to clean the car and less efforts are required to clean hard stains and overall i am extremely satisfied with the product quality and service provided my Detailing Dons *Mr. Nath sir* was gladly prompt and attentive and was assuredly helpful  with explaining the entire procedure. He also kept updating me with the videos of the car when each coat was applied. It’s just amazing who does that now a days providing live video update of your car being serviced *Mr. Nath sir* made sure he was always there when i was in a query and clarified all my quries. I am planning to get done the Ceramic Coating done for my another car from Detailing Dons itself.
According to me you guys have to definitely try out Detailing Dons if you want to get your car paint protected.
